claims.text: Legend says the giant Bran the Blessed, king of Britain, fell trying to take Ireland and asked that the head be buried under the white hill in London to guard against invasion; on the seven-year journey home it stayed uncorrupted and kept its wit.

A second legend ties the land's safety to the ravens of the Tower, and its keepers have long made sure a few remain; during the Second World War, Nazi occultists, or perhaps rogue Technocrats, are said to have tried to reach the head.
